716-8(zha): rnams kyis rab bsngags pa'i//yon tan thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur//sa
716-9(zha): yi khyad par bgrod nas ni//bde ba chen por 'gyur ba yin//sangs rgyas
716-10(zha): kun gyi byang chub sems//sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba rnams//rtogs shing
716-11(zha): 'dzin par byed pa dang //rtag tu 'chang ba gang yin pa//de nyid ba dang
716-12(zha): 'dra bas na//sku gsung thugs kyi dbang rnams dang //gsang ba'i don ni
716-13(zha): bstan pa yin//dngos po rnams kyi dam tshig kyang //mthong zhing thos nas
716-14(zha): rtogs shes yin//dam pa rnams kyi dam pa mchog/de bzhin nyid du gnas
716-15(zha): bcas nas//grol thar lam dang 'khor ba rnams//ji ltar brjod kyang chos
716-16(zha): mchog ste//de bzhin nyid las nyams pa med//de bzhin nyid ni de bzhin
716-17(zha): pas//de la de bzhin gnasa mi bya//gang gis de bzhin gnas gyur na//de
716-18(zha): bzhin mthong bas de bzhin gshegs//de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings nyid la/
716-19(zha): btsal ba med pa'i btsal sems te//dmigs pa med pa'i dmigs pa dang /
716-20(zha): skom du med pa'i sgom pa yis//shes rab gsum gyi bdag nyid can//sa
716-21(zha): rnams ye shes bskyed 'gyur bas//yang dag mthong nas lhun gyis grub//de
717-1(zha): bzhin gshegs pas ra ba bsngags pas//'phags dang byis pa'i skye bo dang
717-2(zha): rang dang gzhan gyi skye bo rnams//gang zhig 'di la da da 'gyur na//dam pa
717-3(zha): 'di dag gnas pa yin//de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i
717-4(zha): 'khor de dag thams cad kyis mgrin gcig dang dbyans gcig tu 'di skad ces
717-5(zha): gsol to//sku gsung thugs kyi bdag po mchog/spyan ras dri med 'od mdzad
717-6(zha): pa//bdag cag kun gyis mthong bas na//d pa' bo chen po khyod phyag 'tshal
717-7(zha): de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis//yang dag rtogs shing 'dzin pa la/
717-8(zha): rab tu mos pas dus gsum du//dpa' bo chen po bzhin phyag 'tshal//byang
717-9(zha): chub 'phags dang gzhan rnams kyis//don 'di 'dzin cing 'chang ba dang //
717-10(zha): rtogs nas sbra bar byed pa la//ston pa bzhin du bdag 'tshal lo//gang gis
717-11(zha): ming tsam 'dzin pa yi//don 'di sgrub par byed pa na//g.yo sgya med cing gus
717-12(zha): ldan pas//dpa' bo bzhin du bdag phyag 'tshal//dpa' bo'i bstan pa bla
717-13(zha): med pa//yi ge med pa'i gsung mchog ste//chos rnams kun gyi rang bzhin la/
717-14(zha): ston pa bzhin du bdag phyag 'tshal//zhes brjod pas/bcom ldan 'das de
717-15(zha): bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po dgyes pa chen po des/nyid kyi dkyil
717-16(zha): 'khor gyis shin tu mnyes par gyur te/dngos po thams cad s+ya ma dang 'dra
717-17(zha): bar mthong nas/sku gsung thugs dzo rdze la zhugs te/cang mi gsung bar gyur
717-18(zha): to//de nas de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs pa thams cad dang /byang chub
717-19(zha): sems dpa' la sogs pa thams cad kyang sku gsung thugs dzo rje la zhugs so//
717-20(zha): zhugs pas phyogs bcu dusa bzhi'i rang bzhin thams cad gcig gi rang bzhin du
717-21(zha): dbyer med pa'i mnyam pa nyid kyi rang bzhin du gyur to//de bzhin gshegs pa
